description: The main window (and further top-level windows, w-*): Tauri's events, dragging the window by its title bar and sidebar header (data-tauri-drag-region; the macOS window has an overlay title bar), double-click to zoom, and the shell's main set. Pitwall's own commands are app commands behind the shell's guard (src-tauri/src/lib.rs COMMANDS), so the UI cannot reach the file system, the shell, the updater or the network directly
